title: Addressed cyclic update step
statement: Let $\delta$ map a state and a list of $\alpha$-values to a state, and let an addressed state have state component $s$, pointer $i$, and array $A$ indexed by $0,\ldots,w$. On input $a\in\alpha$, first replace $A(i)$ by $a$. If $i=w$, apply $\delta$ to $s$ and the updated array read in index order as a list, then set the pointer to $0$; otherwise, keep $s$ unchanged and advance the pointer to $(i+1)\bmod(w+1)$. In either case, the resulting array is the updated array.
